name: Assisted
definition: Entry-level professional; well-defined tasks; work reviewed; knows when to ask.

name: Independent
definition: Performs standard work on their own with normal review; handles routine variation.

name: Proficient
definition: Fully autonomous; handles ambiguity and hard cases; sets the local standard; the go-to.

name: Expert
definition: Defines the approach others adopt; solves problems others can't; teaches the proficient.

name: Authority
definition: Recognized authority across the org; sets the standard/strategy; anticipates direction.

name: Pioneer
definition: Defines the discipline; externally credible; shapes wider industry practice.
